title: Envoy from the Imperial Court
next_chapter_hook: The moment the envoy spoke that name, a long-sealed wound in Chen Ji's heart was suddenly torn open—Chen Tianming, the father he had believed dead for years, was actually still alive, deep within the imperial capital...

text.content: Before the morning mist could fully dissipate, the Blue Stone Plaza before the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate was already filled with people. Chen Ji stood at the very end of the servant disciple line, his thin frame wrapped in a faded blue robe, forming a stark contrast with the solemn-faced Inner Disciples around him. His gaze swept over the crowd and landed on the pitch-black carriage slowly entering the mountain gate—its curtains hung low, yet an invisible pressure radiated outward from within, making even the breathing of those present grow shallow.

dialogue.content: The Sect Gate opens wide, welcoming the honored envoy of the Imperial Court!

text.content: The old Sect Master Ling Yuan personally came out to greet him. The sight of this usually reclusive elder showing such deference before the Imperial Court's carriage caused quite a stir among the disciples present. Chen Ji took all of this in, the corners of his lips twitching slightly—the Imperial Court's hand had finally reached out, and even faster than he had anticipated. The carriage came to a stop, and a maid lifted the curtain. An official boot embroidered with a five-clawed golden dragon stepped out first, followed by a tall figure. The man appeared to be around thirty, his face as fair as jade, with three long whiskers beneath his chin. His crimson official robe was embroidered with intricate auspicious cloud patterns, and the jade pendant hanging from his waist was entirely emerald green, faintly glowing with spiritual light—that was spirit jade unique to the imperial family, which ordinary officials had no right to wear.

dialogue.content: The Crown Prince's envoy has arrived. This old man failed to greet you from afar! May I ask the distinguished official's name?

text.content: The man stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze sweeping through the crowd as if searching for something. When that gaze passed over Chen Ji's location, it paused for a moment—just a moment, so brief that almost no one noticed. Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression remained that of a timid, servile servant as he lowered his head to avoid that scrutinizing look. He knew that his existence had already drawn the attention of the Imperial Court, and this game of chess had begun the moment he stepped out of the servant ranks.

dialogue.content: This official is Zhao Xuanji, unworthy servant as the Crown Prince's Attendant in the Eastern Palace, sent today on a single matter—

text.content: Zhao Xuanji's gaze finally settled on Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, before passing over her and landing on that gray, dusty figure at the very end of the crowd. He curled his lips into a subtle smile, his voice not loud, yet clearly reaching every person present: 'The Crown Prince has heard that the Tianqing Sect possesses an ancient artifact called the Tianji Record. This object concerns the fate of the realm, and His Highness wishes to, in the name of the Imperial Court, jointly explore this opportunity with the Tianqing Sect.' At these words, everyone erupted in shock. The name 'Tianji Record' was unknown to ordinary disciples, yet was now publicly exposed by the Imperial Court's envoy—its implications were self-evident.

choice.prompt: The Imperial Court's envoy publicly named the Tianji Record, shocking all directions. Facing this sudden exposure, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Pretend ignorance, show weakness and endure
choices.description: Present himself as a useless person, appear fearful and uneasy, let the other party despise him, while secretly observing the envoy's true intentions.
choices.visible_cost: May be seen as a soft target, suffering more probing
choices.visible_reward: Hide strength, avoid startling the snake
choices.risk_hint: If the other party already has definite intelligence, may deepen their suspicions

dialogue.content: (Face filled with fear, waving hands repeatedly) This humble one... this humble one does not know what the distinguished official is saying, the Tianji Record? This humble one is merely a servant, how would I know anything about these things...

choices.text: Proactively appear, face the probe directly
choices.description: Step forward boldly from the crowd, neither confirming nor denying, turn the tables by asking as a victim where the Imperial Court got this information, forcing the other party to reveal their cards.
choices.visible_cost: Exposed to the spotlight too early, losing the advantage of concealment
choices.visible_reward: Seize the initiative in dialogue, display extraordinary bearing
choices.risk_hint: If the other party's intelligence is insufficient, the disguise may be exposed on the spot

dialogue.content: (Walking slowly out from the crowd, gaze calm) The distinguished official has traveled a long way, yet opens with the Tianji Record. May I ask where this news came from? The Tianqing Sect has been established for three thousand years, and has never heard of such an object.

text.content: Zhao Xuanji heard this and was not the least bit annoyed; instead, a hint of playful smile appeared on his face. He took a jade slip from his sleeve and tossed it gently into the air. The jade slip suddenly unfurled in mid-air, projecting a screen of light. The light screen displayed a map, with mountains, rivers, and cities rendered in exquisite detail. In the southeastern corner of the map, a complex of buildings surrounded by重重restriction was specially marked in red—that place was unmistakably the location of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds.

dialogue.content: (Expression slightly changed) What does the distinguished official mean by this?

text.content: Zhao Xuanji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his tone still unhurried: 'Elder Ling need not be nervous. His Highness the Crown Prince bears absolutely no ill will toward the Tianqing Sect. On the contrary—' He turned his attention, his gaze once again falling on Chen Ji beyond the crowd, 'His Highness wishes to offer a tremendous opportunity as a gift, in exchange for a private conversation with a certain disciple of your respected sect.' He pointed to that dusty figure, 'That is him, the disciple called atrash—the servant disciple—Chen Ji.'

Silence fell abruptly. Every gaze fell upon Chen Ji in unison—some surprised, some confused, and more filled with schadenfreude in hushed whispers. Su Qingyao furrowed her brow, instinctively taking a step toward Chen Ji, only to be stopped by the elder beside her. A flicker of something indecipherable crossed Ling Yuan's eyes, but he made no move to intervene. Chen Ji felt countless gazes like thorns pricking his back, yet he only slowly raised his head, meeting Zhao Xuanji's gaze.

choice.prompt: The Imperial Court emissary specifically requests to see you, dangling bait about Chen Nian. How will you respond to this move?

choices.text: Follow the trend and accept the deal
choices.description: Pretend to be moved by the筹码 the other party holds, agree to the deal under the pretense of seeking family, but actually use the Imperial Court's power to gain more intelligence and room for action.
choices.visible_cost: You may owe a favor to the Imperial Court and be forced into the succession struggle
choices.visible_reward: Obtain direct intelligence on Chen Nian's location and act with the Imperial Court's support
choices.risk_hint: The Imperial Court's conditions will never be simple—there may be hidden traps

dialogue.content: (His gaze slightly stirred, urgency entering his tone) What Your Excellency says... is it true? If I can find my sister, Chen Ji is willing to hear the Imperial Court's conditions.

choices.description: Do not respond directly, but retreat while advancing—instead ask how they learned of Chen Nian's matters, probing the Imperial Court's intelligence sources and true intentions.
choices.visible_cost: You may anger the emissary and worsen the negotiation atmosphere
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information about the Imperial Court's intelligence network and see through their cards
choices.risk_hint: If the other party has deeper reserves, you may be countered instead

dialogue.content: (Neither servile nor overbearing, he clasped his hands in a formal bow) Since Your Excellency knows my sister's whereabouts, surely you also know she has been missing for years. Your excellency's intelligence is so extensive—I wonder where this information... comes from?

text.content: Zhao Xuanji's eyes flashed sharply, seemingly quite satisfied with Chen Ji's reaction. He waved his attendants to step back several paces, lowering his voice: 'Young Master Chen is indeed extraordinary. To be frank, your sister is now located merely a wall's distance from the Imperial City's Forbidden Grounds. His Highness the Crown Prince wishes to help the young master rescue her, but requires the young master to agree to one thing—' He paused, his gaze burning intently on Chen Ji, 'His Highness only needs the young master to say one 'yes' at a critical moment.'

This sentence seems simple, yet it carries the weight of a thousand jun. Chen Ji's mind raced, instantly parsing the implications—What the Imperial Court wanted was not his allegiance, but a hidden piece that could sway the situation at a crucial moment. The Crown Prince's succession struggle had reached a boiling point; if the Tianji Record's foresight could be utilized for them... He sneered in his heart, the Imperial Court's calculations were quite clever. Unfortunately, what they did not know was that every use of the Tianji Record consumed precious Heavenly Fate Value, and his Heavenly Fate Value... was nearly exhausted.

Chen Ji lowered his gaze to contemplate briefly. When he raised his head again, his face had already changed to an expression of hesitation and struggle. He knew that this moment's performance would determine the starting point of his chess game with the Imperial Court—acting too fake would arouse suspicion, acting too well would make people think he was easy to manipulate. He took a deep breath, his voice slightly trembling: 'Your Excellency... Your Excellency can really save my sister? My sister has been missing for years, and I have searched everywhere in vain. If the Imperial Court truly has this ability...' He gritted his teeth, as if making a difficult decision, 'Chen Ji is willing to hear the conditions.'

choice.prompt: The emissary proposes the vague condition of 'saying yes at a critical moment' and reveals the Dragon Veil hidden within the Imperial City's Forbidden Grounds. How do you respond?

choices.text: First state conditions, then reveal your cards
choices.description: Demand the emissary first provide specific information on Chen Nian's location and details about the Dragon Veil as a show of good faith, otherwise everything is off the table—exchange筹码 for more intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: You may be seen as ungrateful and anger the emissary
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence about the Imperial City's Forbidden Grounds and break the information asymmetry
choices.risk_hint: If the other party refuses, you need a backup plan

dialogue.content: (His gaze slightly solidified) Since Your Excellency wishes Chen Ji's assistance at a critical moment, shouldn't Chen Ji at least know when and what this 'critical moment' is? If the Dragon Veil's location and details of the Imperial City's Forbidden Grounds could be shared, Chen Ji can then judge whether this matter is feasible.

choices.text: Play along while secretly laying plans
choices.description: Pretending to agree to cooperate, while actually extracting more specific intelligence about the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds and Chen Nian, laying the groundwork for future actions.
choices.visible_cost: If exposed, he would completely lose the trust of the Imperial Court.
choices.visible_reward: Gain cooperation qualification and intelligence channels, preserving room for later turning against them.
choices.risk_hint: Requires maintaining the disguise for a long period, draining energy and effort.

dialogue.content: (After a moment of contemplation, he nodded) The Imperial Court has shown sincerity, and Chen Ji is not one to be ungrateful. However, this matter carries tremendous significance. Could the esteemed official grant Chen Ji three days? Within three days, I shall certainly provide an answer.

text.content: Zhao Xuanji seemed to have anticipated Chen Ji's response long ago. His smile on his face not only did not fade but actually deepened. He took out a token from his bosom and gently placed it in Chen Ji's palm. The token felt slightly heavy in the hand, its entire body as black as ink. On the front was an ancient and simple character "皇" (Imperial), while on the back was a winding dragon-shaped pattern, faintly emanating spiritual light. "This is a token bestowed personally by His Highness the Crown Prince. Three days later, present this token to enter the Imperial City, and His Highness will personally welcome the young master at the Imperial Garden." He lowered his voice, "At that time, the answers the young master wishes to know... will all be forthcoming."

Just as Chen Ji tucked the token into his sleeve, Zhao Xuanji spoke again, this time his voice pressed even lower, audible only to Chen Ji alone: "By the way, there is one more matter. His Highness has instructed this official to relay to the young master—" He paused, a deeply meaningful light flickering in his eyes, "Your father, Chen Tianming, did not die in an accident back then. He... is still among the living, deep within the Imperial City." These words struck like thunder, exploding in Chen Ji's mind. His fingers trembled slightly, but his expression remained unruffled as he merely lowered his gaze and said, "Many thanks to the official for informing me."

Zhao Xuanji gazed at Chen Ji's unruffled face, a flash of appreciation flickering in his eyes—this young man was far steadier than he had imagined. He patted Chen Ji's shoulder and said loudly: "In three days, this official awaits the young master Chen's distinguished presence at the Imperial City." With that, he turned to take his leave from Ling Yuan. Surrounded by a host of disciples, he boarded his carriage and departed grandly from the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate. As the carriage gradually disappeared into the distance, Chen Ji stood rooted in place for a long while, clutching the cold token in his sleeve, his heart churning with monstrous waves—Father... is actually still alive?

The crowd gradually dispersed, leaving only Chen Ji standing alone in the center of the plaza. The morning mist had cleared completely, and brilliant sunlight shone upon him, yet it could not dispel thegrave (heavy) gloom between his brows. The token in his sleeve seemed to weigh a thousand tons, constantly reminding him—the journey to the Imperial City in three days would be a true dragon's pool and tiger's den. And he must make thorough preparations before then. In the distance, Su Qingyao's figure flashed at the end of the corridor, seemingly wanting to approach, but was stopped by someone. Chen Ji observed all of this with keen eyes, the corners of his lips slightly rising—the Imperial Court, the Crown Prince, the Tianji Record, Chen Nian, Father... all the clues point to the same place: the Imperial City Forbidden Grounds.

He drew a deep breath, turned, and walked toward the Servants' Quarters. Behind him, the Tianqing Sect's mountain gate glistened under the sunlight, appearing peaceful and harmonious on the surface, yet beneath churned hidden currents. In three days, when he steps into the Imperial City, this prolonged chess game spanning many years will welcome its most critical move. And Chen Ji will never be content to be a chess piece in another's hands—what he aims to become is the Chess Player. However, at this moment, he remains unaware that those eyes which have been watching him from the shadows have long since taken in all his strategies...
